es: Sabado de madrugada sin apertura de NY: BTC y ETH pasaron toda la noche y Asia/Londres metidos en sus bandas de no-trade de ayer, ninguna zona llego a su gatillo.

Riesgo de noticias sube de MEDIO a ALTO: el hackeo de Binance (6.3 mil millones) sigue dentro de las 24 horas desde el primer titular (unas 20h), y la regla dura manda ALTO en toda esa ventana aunque el precio ya lo absorbiera; se suma un segundo incidente menor en Chainalysis (investigador blockchain), sin relacion de precio todavia.

BTC enfrio su apalancamiento (OI +3.7% en 24h, bajo el +6.1% de anoche: ya no cumple el umbral de largos cargados) pero sigue sin tocar ni el VAH ni su zona de venta A+ mas arriba. ETH dejo de perder posiciones (OI de -4.7% a +0.05%) y mantiene el funding negativo (shorts pagando) a su favor, pero tampoco llego a sus zonas.

Veredicto sin cambios en los dos: WAIT. BTC sigue con su zona A+ de venta (78,110 a 78,804) lejos del precio; ETH sigue con sus dos zonas B (compra 2,208 a 2,241, venta 2,261 a 2,296), ninguna A+ todavia.
en: Early Saturday, no NY open: BTC and ETH spent the whole night and the Asia/London stretch parked inside yesterday's no-trade bands, neither zone reached its trigger.

News risk steps up from MEDIUM to HIGH: the Binance hack ($6.3B) is still inside the 24-hour window from its first headline (about 20h ago), and the hard rule keeps risk HIGH for that whole window even though price already absorbed it; a second, smaller incident at Chainalysis (blockchain investigator) adds to the headline flow, with no direct price link yet.

BTC cooled its leverage (OI +3.7% in 24h, down from +6.1% last night: no longer meets the crowded-longs threshold) but still has not touched its VAH or the A+ sell zone above. ETH stopped bleeding positions (OI from -4.7% to +0.05%) and keeps the negative funding (shorts paying) in its favor, but also has not reached its zones yet.
Verdict unchanged on both: WAIT. BTC still has its A+ sell zone (78,110 to 78,804) far from price; ETH still has its two B zones (buy 2,208 to 2,241, sell 2,261 to 2,296), neither A+ yet.

setup.es: Vigilar una barrida y reclamo entre 2,208 y 2,241 (swing bajo de 1h, VAL de ayer, FVG de 1h) para un largo con el viento de cola del funding negativo de fin de semana; si en vez de eso ETH sube directo a probar 2,261 a 2,296 (PDH y FVG encima), ahi se evalua la venta, pero con peor R:R.
setup.en: Watch for a sweep and reclaim between 2,208 and 2,241 (1h swing low, yesterday's VAL, 1h FVG) for a long riding the weekend negative-funding tailwind; if ETH instead runs straight up to test 2,261 to 2,296 (PDH plus the FVG stack above it), evaluate the short there instead, though with worse R:R.

ETH: funding negativo (-0.0095% / 8h), shorts pagando, y el OI dejo de caer (de -4.7% a +0.05% en 24h, posiciones estables): sigue el contexto medido 5 de 5 fines de semana al alza para ETH.
deriv.en: BTC: funding capped at the normal ceiling but leverage cooled off (OI +3.7% in 24h, down from +6.1% last night: no longer meets the crowded-longs threshold under this resistance). ETH: negative funding (-0.0095% / 8h), shorts paying, and OI stopped falling (from -4.7% to +0.05% in 24h, positions stable): still the measured 5-for-5 weekend tailwind for ETH.

drivers.headline: Binance hack: $6.3B, the largest crypto theft on record

note.es: Sigue dentro de la ventana dura de 24h desde el primer titular (hace unas 20h): el riesgo se queda en ALTO aunque el precio ya lo absorbio (BTC y ETH siguen arriba en 24h). La historia sigue generando titulares nuevos cada hora (el ultimo, sobre la seguridad de los wallets, hace menos de 1h).
note.en: Still inside the hard 24h window from the first headline (about 20h ago): risk stays HIGH even though price already absorbed it (BTC and ETH are still up over 24h). The story keeps generating fresh headlines every hour (the latest, on wallet safety, is under 1h old).

note.en: A second cybersecurity incident, separate from the Binance hack and at an investigation firm, not an exchange or ETH: still no direct price link, named as a headline to watch, not a confirmed driver.

note.es: Riesgo ALTO (subido de MEDIO en el close): el hackeo de Binance sigue dentro de la ventana dura de 24h desde el primer titular, asi que el riesgo no baja aunque el precio ya lo absorbiera; se suma un segundo incidente menor en Chainalysis. Fin de semana de liquidez fina sigue: BTC enfrio su apalancamiento (ya no cumple 'largos cargados') y ETH dejo de perder posiciones, con el funding negativo todavia a su favor. note.en: Risk HIGH (up from MEDIUM at the close): the Binance hack is still inside the hard 24h window from its first headline, so risk does not come down even though price already absorbed it; a second, smaller Chainalysis incident adds to the flow. Thin weekend liquidity continues: BTC cooled its leverage (no longer meets 'crowded longs') and ETH stopped bleeding positions, with negative funding still in its favor. No USD calendar event inside this plan's window.

context.es: Toda la noche y Asia/Londres sin salir de la banda de no-trade entre el POC (77,016) y el VAH (77,974) de ayer: rango de 631 puntos, solo 29% del ATR diario, sin tocar ni ese techo ni la zona de venta A+ mas arriba (78,110 a 78,804, todavia 0.7 a 1.6% lejos). El indicador de regimen paso de alcista a neutral y el checklist de tendencia perdio su veredicto confirmado (3 cambios de veredicto hoy, dia sin direccion clara); el sesgo diario y semanal siguen bajistas. Los largos de BTC enfriaron el apalancamiento (OI +3.7% en 24h, bajo el +6.1% de anoche).
context.en: All night and through Asia/London without leaving yesterday's no-trade band between the POC (77,016) and the VAH (77,974): a 631-point range, only 29% of the daily ATR, without touching either that ceiling or the A+ sell zone higher up (78,110 to 78,804, still 0.7 to 1.6% away). The regime indicator flipped from bullish to neutral and the trend checklist lost its confirmed verdict (3 verdict changes today, a day without a clear direction); the daily and weekly bias stay bearish. BTC's longs cooled their leverage (OI +3.7% in 24h, down from +6.1% last night).

why.es: Confluencia: PDH 78,804 (pivote +1) junto al swing alto de 1h 78,110 (S/R multi-TF +1), hueco bajista de 1h 78,241 a 78,418 (FVG de TF mayor, +2), zona dorada corta 77,857 a 78,274 (+1) y el checklist de tendencia a favor del corto (+1) = 6, A+. Contra las 24 h (que subieron 0.19%), asi que cumple la jerarquia cripto de reversion. Largos de BTC cargados (funding al tope + OI +6% en 24 h) bajo este techo: si se rompe a la baja puede ser barrida rapida, pero esto todavia no esta medido (va aparte, no suma al score).
why.en: Confluence: PDH 78,804 (pivot +1) next to the 1h swing high 78,110 (multi-TF S/R +1), the 1h bearish gap 78,241 to 78,418 (FVG at a higher TF, +2), the short golden zone 77,857 to 78,274 (+1) and the trend checklist favoring the short (+1) = 6, A+. Against the 24h move (which was up 0.19%), so it fits the crypto reversal hierarchy. BTC's longs are crowded (funding capped + OI +6% in 24h) right under this ceiling: a break down could sweep fast, but that is not measured yet (noted separately, not added to score).

context.es: Precio respeto el techo de ayer (VAH 2,249.74) toda la noche: 9 toques con mecha hasta 2,255.58 y cierre de vuelta abajo (barrida de maximo de Asia con reclamo). Rango apretado de 18.6 puntos, solo 20% del ATR diario, sin llegar a la zona de compra (2,208 a 2,241, el minimo del dia solo rozo el borde alto en 2,237) ni a la de venta (2,260 a 2,296, el maximo del dia se quedo en 2,255.58, bajo el PDH). El checklist de tendencia sigue sin veredicto confirmado (igual que en el close) y el sesgo diario/semanal sigue bajista contra la sesion y drbias, que leen alcista: mismo conflicto de marcos. El OI de ETH dejo de caer (de -4.7% a +0.05% en 24h) y el funding sigue negativo (shorts pagando).
context.en: Price respected yesterday's ceiling (VAH 2,249.74) all night: 9 touches with a wick up to 2,255.58 and a close back below (an Asia-high sweep with a reclaim). A tight 18.6-point range, only 20% of the daily ATR, without reaching the buy zone (2,208 to 2,241, today's low only grazed the top edge at 2,237) or the sell zone (2,260 to 2,296, today's high topped out at 2,255.58, below the PDH). The trend checklist still has no confirmed verdict (same as at the close) and the daily/weekly bias stays bearish against the session read and drbias, which read bullish: same frame conflict. ETH's OI stopped falling (from -4.7% to +0.05% in 24h) and funding stays negative (shorts paying).

why.es: Confluencia: VAL de ayer 2,218.67 y POC 2,230.55 en la zona (nivel de perfil +1), zona dorada larga 2,193 a 2,208 justo debajo (+1), hueco alcista de 1h 2,236.43 a 2,241.31 (FVG de TF mayor, +2) y la excepcion de funding por apalancamiento (ETH shorts pagando este fin de semana, zona larga de barrida/reclamo suma +1, maximo +1) = 5, B. Va CON las 24 h (que subieron 1.27%), asi que la jerarquia cripto la topa en B aunque sume mas: la regla de 'contra las 24 h' solo da A+ en reversion.
why.en: Confluence: yesterday's VAL 2,218.67 and POC 2,230.55 inside the zone (profile level +1), the long golden zone 2,193 to 2,208 just below (+1), the 1h bullish gap 2,236.43 to 2,241.31 (FVG at a higher TF, +2) and the leverage/funding exception (ETH shorts paying this weekend, a long sweep/reclaim zone gets +1, max +1) = 5, B. It goes WITH the 24h move (which was up 1.27%), so the crypto hierarchy caps it at B even though it scores higher: the 'against the 24h' rule only grants A+ on reversal.

Pide confirmacion extra en cualquiera de las dos antes de entrar.

Needs extra confirmation on either before entering.

counterCase.es: El funding negativo de ETH (shorts pagando) es la pista mas fuerte del plan para el largo, pero la muestra es chica (n chico, 5 de 5 fines de semana medidos) y el marco de 1h/4h sigue bajista: si el reclamo en 2,208 a 2,241 falla y pierde el swing bajo de 1h (2,208.40) con cierre abajo, el camino abierto es hacia 2,174 (PDL) y cancela el largo.
counterCase.en: ETH's negative funding (shorts paying) is the strongest clue in the plan for the long, but the sample is small (5-for-5 weekends measured, small n) and the 1h/4h frame is still bearish: if the reclaim at 2,208 to 2,241 fails and loses the 1h swing low (2,208.40) with a close below, the path opens toward 2,174 (PDL) and the long is off.

updated.es: Sabado de madrugada, sin apertura de NY: ninguna zona de BTC ni de ETH llego a su gatillo durante la noche ni en Asia/Londres, los dos siguen en WAIT igual que en el close. Lo que cambio: el riesgo de noticias sube de MEDIO a ALTO (el hackeo de Binance sigue dentro de la ventana dura de 24h, mas un segundo incidente menor en Chainalysis); el indicador de regimen y el checklist de tendencia de BTC pasaron de alcista/confirmado-corto a neutral/sin veredicto (dia sin direccion clara); BTC enfrio su apalancamiento (OI +3.7% vs +6.1% de anoche) y ETH dejo de perder posiciones (OI de -4.7% a +0.05%), con el funding negativo todavia a su favor. Zonas, rangos, confluencia y predicciones intactos.
updated.en: Early Saturday, no NY open: neither BTC's nor ETH's zones reached their trigger overnight or through Asia/London, both stay in WAIT just like at the close. What changed: news risk steps up from MEDIUM to HIGH (the Binance hack is still inside the hard 24h window, plus a second, smaller Chainalysis incident); BTC's regime indicator and trend checklist flipped from bullish/confirmed-short to neutral/no-verdict (a day without a clear direction); BTC cooled its leverage (OI +3.7% vs +6.1% last night) and ETH stopped bleeding positions (OI from -4.7% to +0.05%), with negative funding still in its favor. Zones, ranges, confluence and predictions are unchanged.
